review_candidates.description: Company Description El Ghanam Textile Company is a growing textile manufacturer and distributor based in Cairo, Egypt, serving local and regional markets. The company focuses on producing quality fabrics and textile products that meet diverse customer needs in fashion, home textiles, and industrial applications. El Ghanam Textile Company values reliability, operational efficiency, and long-term partnerships with suppliers and clients. Team members are encouraged to contribute to continuous improvement, support accurate business decision-making, and help maintain strong financial performance. Role Description The Accountant role at El Ghanam Textile Company is a full-time, hybrid position based in Cairo, Egypt, with some flexibility to work from home. The Accountant will handle day-to-day financial transactions, including recording entries in the general ledger, processing invoices, managing accounts payable and receivable, and reconciling bank statements. This role will prepare periodic financial reports, assist with budgeting and forecasting, and help ensure compliance with local accounting standards and tax regulations. The Accountant will support month-end and year-end closing activities, maintain accurate financial documentation, and collaborate with internal teams to provide timely financial data and analysis. The role may also involve supporting internal audits, improving financial processes, and contributing to cost control and inventory accounting in the textile production environment. Qualifications Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, and general ledger management. Experience with accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, and cash flow tracking. Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Excel; familiarity with ERP systems is an advantage. Understanding of local tax regulations, compliance requirements, and audit procedures in Egypt. Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (or equivalent relevant experience). Excellent attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and organizational skills. Ability to analyze financial data, identify variances, and prepare clear reports for management. Effective communication skills and ability to collaborate with operations, procurement, and management teams. Ability to manage multiple deadlines, work independently, and adapt to a hybrid work environment. Prior experience in manufacturing or textile industry accounting is a plus.

review_candidates.title: Generative AI Intern
review_candidates.description: 📝 Generative AI Intern (Unpaid) ⚠️ Applications will only be accepted through the following site: 👉 www.owlera.site About Owlera Owlera is an AI-powered career platform that helps students and fresh graduates gain practical experience through internship simulations inspired by real companies. Participants work on realistic business challenges, receive AI-powered feedback, use modern professional tools, and build portfolio-ready projects that demonstrate their abilities to future employers. We're looking for curious, inventive, and ambitious students to join our Generative AI Internship and gain hands-on experience building with the tools that are reshaping every industry — large language models, AI agents, and multimodal generative systems. About the Internship As a Generative AI Intern, you'll work on realistic generative-AI challenges involving text generation, AI assistants, RAG systems, and agentic workflows — building applications that reason, create, and act with real language models. You'll learn how AI practitioners turn raw model capabilities into working products — designing prompts and evaluation sets, orchestrating agents and tools, and handling the quirks of real-world model behavior. Responsibilities * Design and iterate on prompts for text generation, classification, and reasoning tasks. * Build LLM-powered features using APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight models). * Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over documents and knowledge bases. * Build simple AI agents that can use tools, browse, and complete multi-step tasks. * Create evaluation sets and run model evaluations (accuracy, faithfulness, refusal behavior). * Experiment with function calling, structured outputs, and prompt chaining. * Prototype AI chatbots and copilots for realistic use cases. * Work with embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search. * Generate synthetic data to train or evaluate models. * Implement guardrails and safety checks for model outputs. * Fine-tune or LoRA-adapt smaller models for specific tasks. * Compare models and select the right model for each task (cost vs quality tradeoffs). * Experiment with multimodal models (text + image, vision-language tasks). * Build simple demos with Streamlit, Gradio, or web interfaces. * Track experiments and write clear documentation of results and learnings. * Collaborate with other interns on cross-functional AI projects. * Turn real-world problems into generative-AI product formulations. Requirements * Current student or recent graduate in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or a related field — or a strong self-taught coding portfolio. * Strong interest in large language models and generative AI. * Basic programming skills (Python is a plus). * Comfortable with basic math — probability, statistics, and linear algebra at an introductory level. * Analytical and logical thinking with close attention to detail. * Self-motivated and able to work independently on technical challenges. * Comfortable experimenting, failing fast, and iterating. * Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms is a plus. * Previous professional machine-learning experience is not required. What You'll Gain * Hands-on experience building real generative-AI applications, not just theory. * Practical experience with LLMs, RAG pipelines, and AI agents. * Experience evaluating and improving AI systems on realistic tasks. * Understanding of how AI features are designed, shipped, and iterated. * Practical exposure to modern LLM APIs, vector databases, and agent frameworks. * Portfolio-ready generative-AI projects built on realistic use cases. * Personalized AI feedback on your work. * Professional certificate upon successful completion. * Mentorship and weekly learning sessions. * Opportunity to strengthen your portfolio, resume, and interview readiness. Internship Details Role: Generative AI Intern Location: Remote Type: Internship (Unpaid) Level: Entry Level Duration: 6 Weeks Commitment: Flexible (approximately 10–15 hours per week) If you're fascinated by what large language models can build and want to learn how real generative-AI products are created, we'd love to hear from you. ⚠️ Apply through: 👉 www.owlera.site

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer II - Remote Desktop Protocol & Redirection
review_candidates.description: Overview Join the Windows Cloud Experiences team to build core Windows client technologies that power secure, high-performance remote desktop experiences at global scale. As part of the Windows + Devices organization, you will design and ship foundational Windows client components that integrate with the operating system, devices, and hardware while connecting to cloud-powered services. This role is suited for engineers with experience building native C++ software close to the operating system, particularly in performance-sensitive and reliability-critical environments. You will solve systems-level problems, contribute to technical design decisions, and own well-scoped features and components through the engineering lifecycle. Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. Responsibilities Build Core Windows Client and Device Experiences Implement native Windows components in modern C++, integrating with Win32, COM, Windows services, and system APIs. Build capabilities involving device redirection, input, display, audio/video, USB, and HID integration for remote desktop and virtualization scenarios. Develop and maintain cross-process, cross-thread, performance-critical code paths where correctness, latency, reliability, and stability are important. Contribute to technical design decisions and evaluate tradeoffs across the Windows client components and devices you work on. Systems-Level Engineering Investigate and resolve systems-level issues spanning kernel and user-mode boundaries, operating system integration, drivers, services, and client applications. Optimize memory usage, threading models, IPC, and I/O within complex, long-running Windows client processes. Diagnose performance, reliability, memory, and concurrency issues using telemetry, traces, dumps, debuggers, and other diagnostic tools. Partner with Windows platform, security, device, and other engineering teams to design robust and secure implementations. Work through technically ambiguous problems with the team, identify appropriate engineering tradeoffs, and carry solutions across component boundaries. Technical Ownership Own well-scoped features across the engineering lifecycle, including design, implementation, testing, deployment, telemetry, and live-site debugging. Contribute to design and code reviews, and apply engineering practices for testability, performance, reliability, and long-term maintainability. Contribute to iterative improvements to Windows client technologies in an agile engineering environment with frequent releases. Investigate customer and production issues, determine root causes, and implement engineering improvements that reduce recurrence. Share systems-level knowledge through design discussions and code reviews, and contribute to raising engineering quality across the team. Technologies You May Work Across Technologies Including C++ for native Windows and systems-level development. C#, .NET, and WinUI. Win32, WinRT, COM, RPC, Windows services, and system APIs. Windows input, graphics, audio/video, networking, and device stacks. Windows diagnostics and debugging technologies, including ETW, traces, dumps, and debuggers. Qualifications Required/Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 2+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C++, C# OR equivalent experience. Additional Or Preferred Qualifications Other Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. Preferred Qualifications Experience developing native Windows applications or system components. Experience with Win32, COM, Windows services, or Windows system APIs. Experience debugging performance, memory, threading, or concurrency issues in native code. Experience with device integration, USB, HID, audio/video, or driver-adjacent development. Familiarity with remote desktop or virtualization technologies such as RDP or ICA. Experience using ETW, traces, dumps, or debuggers for Windows diagnostics. Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly to improve development, testing, or debugging workflows. #W+DJOBS #WCXEngineeringJobs #WAEngineeringJobs Software Engineering IC3 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $102,100 - $202,200 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $133,800 - $219,200 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here: https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/us-corporate-pay This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer.
